verdict.rationale: Pipedream exposes a large browsable catalog of 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools. Each app has its own dedicated MCP server and a per-app page listing its tools (e.g. 'OpenAI: 46 actions · 4 triggers'). An app-marketplace index is published via llms.txt and capability summaries are shown per app (e.g. Slack: send messages, manage channels). However, no evidence shows a search or filter-by-capability function across the catalog; discovery appears to be browsing app by app. Missing for 10: documented catalog search/filter by capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of the discovery experience.
